links.outcome: AUC inflation from preprocessing (SMOTE) leakage, global versus nested comparison
links.effect: SMOTE leakage inflated AUC by a pooled 0.09 (95% CI 0.07, 0.11; p < 0.001), exceeding 0.05 in 64% of datasets.
links.quote: Across the 50 datasets, SMOTE leakage inflated AUC by a pooled 0.09 (95% confidence interval (CI): 0.07, 0.11; p < 0.001), exceeding 0.05 in 64%.

links.outcome: Sensitivity of performance and patient classifications to pipeline choice
links.effect: Pipeline choice shifted AUC by 0.30; near-optimal pipelines disagreed on 20-30% of patient classifications (Fleiss kappa = 0.58) and shared <30% of top features.
links.quote: At ε = 5%, near-optimal pipelines disagreed on 20-30% of patient classifications (Fleiss kappa = 0.58) and shared < 30% of top features.
